from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
target=repo/'tests/test_workday_adapter.py'
original=subprocess.run(['git','show','HEAD:tests/test_workday_adapter.py'],cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
current=target.read_text()
status=subprocess.run(['git','status','--short'],cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
print('STATUS_BEFORE',status)
if current==original:
 print('ALREADY_CLEAN');raise SystemExit(0)
marker='\n@pytest.mark.asyncio\nasync def test_registration_respects_aria_disabled_submit_control():'
if current.count(marker)!=1 or not current.startswith(original) or not current[len(original):].strip().startswith('@pytest.mark.asyncio'):
 raise SystemExit('UNEXPECTED_TEST_MODIFICATIONS_ABORT')
suffix=current[len(original):]
if 'test_registration_respects_aria_disabled_submit_control' not in suffix or 'window.clicked === undefined' not in suffix:
 raise SystemExit('SUFFIX_MISMATCH_ABORT')
target.write_text(original)
print('RESTORED_ONLY_OWN_FAILED_REQUEST_TEST')
print('STATUS_AFTER',subprocess.run(['git','status','--short'],cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout)
